title: The Substitution (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational soccer philosophy 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal absurdist sport football
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The substitution board goes up and shows a number that is yours
And you've been on the pitch for sixty-seven minutes of the cause
The manager has decided that the seventy-first minute needs new energy
And the energy is currently sitting on the bench with strategy

[Pre-Chorus]
You jog towards the line and the crowd gives a polite reception
Which is the sporting world's version of a sincere misdirection

[Chorus]
The substitution knows something I don't know
It knows the exact moment when a fresh pair of legs should go
The substitution is a conversation that was had at half time
About the state of the second half — the call, the sign
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The man coming on is full of energy and running at the game
The man coming off is giving everything he had left — all the same
They pass each other at the touchline for a second in the light
Both of them performing for the crowd who watch the sight

[Bridge]
I've been substituted in my life at various positions
By younger versions of ideas that arrived with better visions
The manager of life doesn't show you any board
You just notice someone younger running to fill your accord

[Outro]
Substitution knows… fresh legs, final third… substitution knows
That's my boy
